name: Ferryman Odo
place: poles a boat nobody else can see between Gullwick and Ferry Hythe, and wants his fare
_doc: Stream E (M2). A drowned ferryman. He asks a fare of everyone together — a STACK: all of you in one circle splits the cost. His pole sweeps a wide cone, and at half health the lake rises: safe circles of dry ground, everything else is cold water.

party.solo: Solo: the fare is heavy alone (need 3) — save a defensive skill for it.
party.small: Workable at 2-3; the fare still hits hard at 2.
party.full: Easy — this is a fight that wants a crowd.
party.m5: M5 lowers the fare's `need` to the party size (minimum 1).

pull: "Fare, please." The voice comes up out of the water.
A pole taps the shore. "Crossing? It's one coin. Each. Forever."
say.death: Ferryman Odo sinks into the lake, finally off duty.
say.reset: Odo poles away into the mist.

fare.name: Everyone's Fare
fare.say: "Fare's due!" — huddle with {target}, all of you!

flood.name: Rising Water
flood.say: The lake rises — get onto dry ground!

phases.name: High Water
phases.say: "No fare, no crossing. No crossing... no land."
